question: Jaita is the main dance form of which state?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Uttar Pradesh.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **J****aita **is a folk dance of **Uttar Pradesh, **in the region of **Benrkhand. **
 
• This dance is performed during **marriage ceremonies **and **for the bravery and warriors of Jaat Community**.
 
• This dance is performed by a **group of male dancers called Jatis**, who form a circle and make noise with traditional songs and local stories
 
• It is characterised by powerful movements of bows and arrows with coordination.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 

 **States**
 **Some important dances**
 
 

 Uttar Pradesh
 Raslila, Kajri, Jhora, Chappeli, and Nautanki
 
 

 Karnataka
 Yakshagana, Dollu Kunitha, Bhootha Aradhane, Kamsale, Karaga festival, Bolak-aat dance and Veeragase.
 
 

 Rajasthan
 Ghoomar, Kathputli, Bhopa, Chang, Teratali, Grindr, Kachchhighori and Tejaji.
 
 

 Madhya Pradesh
 Jawara, Matki, Aada, Khada Nach, Phulpati, Grida Dance, Selalarki, Selabhadoni and Maanch.
